sources.title: Random treasure
sources.summary: Random treasure fills a value budget. Items in a pool can appear, but are neither guaranteed nor equally likely.
conditions: Candidates must fit the remaining budget and the source's minimum item value. Coins and valuables bypass the minimum but still spend the budget. The minimum does not shrink as the budget is spent.
Ordinary skeleton, chest, ruin and nest pools exclude food and material/ignition items, including wood, rocks, flint, feathers, pelts and several potion ingredients.
Raving Unwanted and Mutated Unwanted allow those item classes but have a smaller fixed budget. Creature meat and gland drops and the dead camp's supplies are separate.
Random budgets favor smaller amounts by mixing several uniform integer ranges. The Unwanted corpse budget is fixed. Each accepted item spends its base value, even if worn.

Generation stops when the budget is spent or 500 counted candidates have been tried. Value and type rejections count; undefined items and the early Summoning Stone story exclusion do not. The limit can leave a budget partly unspent.

Coins and valuables stack through repeated 80% continuation checks. Each extra unit must fit the stack limit and cost strictly less than the extra-unit budget. Other items usually receive wear, reducing resale value.
Story requirements below also apply. Non-lootable items stay excluded.
Per-container item probabilities depend on budget, previous selections, story state, attempt limits and any later retention checks. Exact per-item rates are unknown.
sources.image_caption: Coins are one possible treasure find.

sources.title: Skeletons and corpses
sources.summary: Randomly placed skeletons and partially clothed bodies generate treasure when first opened.
conditions: Indoor remains have larger budgets and higher minimum non-valuable item values than outdoor remains.
All three appearances use the same treasure rules.
Reopening does not reroll treasure. Contents can deteriorate or disappear over time.
Fresh creature drops, Raving and Mutated Unwanted loot and the dead camp's supplies use separate rules.

sources.title: Treasure chests

Chests use ordinary treasure exclusions: richer chests still exclude food and many materials. The minimum non-valuable item value rises with the rolled budget.
Chest loot receives ordinary wear; chests do not use a reduced-wear pool.

Willow and Cypress switch their thin-versus-developed primary wood at a growth factor of 0.2. Bark also requires a trunk or a side branch whose growth factor is above 0.33.
Bramble and Rift Vine berry success increases with growth; there is no single fixed berry percentage for all bushes. Elderwort instead switches to berries at its berry-producing foliage stage.
Green Fingers can add one berry to a successful Bramble, Rift Vine or Elderwort berry drop. Only Bramble and Elderwort berry drops use the special extra-insect path described at Harvested insects.

Living fuel pieces can be wet when they fall. Chopping yields the listed twigs, branches and logs; Firewood is the result of its separate crafting recipes, not the automatic primary yield of every chopped tree.
A branch carrying a beehive has additional Honey and Beeswax; see Beehives.

sources.title: Night fireflies
sources.summary: At night outdoors, collectible Firefly patches can appear near the player.
sources.image_caption: A successfully spawned patch contains a small group of Fireflies.
conditions: The outdoor dark-time update can attempt a patch when fewer than five Firefly containers are present. It uses a 50% placement-attempt check and a bounded location search.
Placement still needs a free, non-solid, unoccupied tile within the required distance of the player. A failed search creates no patch.
That percentage is a spawn-attempt check in that update path, not an item drop chance on every player action. Once a patch exists, its initial inventory contains the quantity below.

sources.title: Story rewards and finds
sources.summary: These scripted story interactions provide particular items. They are separate from ordinary corpse drops, merchant stock and the dead camp's two fixed supply inventories.
sources.image_caption: Ancient Strongbox is found through the library's designated search target.
conditions: This page contains story spoilers. A guaranteed row means the specified interaction gives that item, not that any NPC conversation or any ruin search does so.
The Wooden Recorder comes from the separately interactive dead Unwanted at the camp, not the body pile containing the Herbalist's Belt and not the wooden supply container.

Rift sampling is available at or before Clay's early request for three samples and stops after that quest step. The interaction also requires the player to carry fewer than three Rift Weaves; each successful sample produces one.

Library shelves are initialized with empty search targets and one selected strongbox target. A retrying 2.5% placement check chooses the target; this is not a flat 2.5% chance each time the player searches a shelf.
The Summoning Stone story grants listed here are distinct from its conditional membership in random treasure pools.

pools.title: Larger searchable ruins
pools.summary: The budget ranges from 1 silver to 3 silver and 40 copper. Non-valuable items must be worth at least 1 silver, and every item must occupy fewer than four inventory squares.
pools.odds_note: Exact per-item odds are unknown. Budget, earlier selections and the 500-candidate limit affect the result.

pools.title: Smaller searchable ruins
pools.summary: The unadjusted budget ranges from 30 copper to 1 silver and 50 copper. Budgets below the 50-copper minimum non-valuable item value are raised to 60 copper. Items must occupy fewer than four inventory squares.
pools.odds_note: Exact per-item odds are unknown. Budget, earlier selections and the 500-candidate limit affect the result.

pools.title: Bird-nest bonus treasure
pools.summary: The unadjusted budget ranges from 10 copper to 1 silver and 50 copper. A budget below the 15-copper minimum non-valuable item value becomes 25 copper. Only one-square items qualify.
pools.odds_note: Exact per-item odds are unknown. Budget, earlier selections and the 500-candidate limit affect the result.

pools.odds_note: Exact per-item odds are unknown. Budget, earlier selections and the 500-candidate limit affect the result.

pools.title: Raving and Mutated Unwanted corpse treasure
